Chapter 279 End Of Dispute

Infinite anger surged from the bottom of his heart, and the phantom never expected that the result would be like this this time.

No matter how I calculate it, I also lost.

And it's a blood loss!

The phantom stared at Lu Daosheng and the others, wishing they could eat them raw.

But at this moment, he was a little powerless.

"You guys, wait!"

Seeing that the other party was still threatening at this time, Lu Daosheng immediately chuckled and said, "Oh? Depending on what you mean, don't you want your descendants to come to our side?"

"If that happens, I'll leave."

"Oh by the way, no luck will be returned."

Hearing this, the phantom fell silent.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng and the others were about to turn around and leave, the phantom quickly spoke.

"Let's wait!"

Lu Daosheng and the others stopped.

The phantom took a deep breath and said slowly, "Wait for a moment."

I saw the phantom turn back and then stretched out his big hand.

After a moment, several balls of light flew towards here from the depths of the void.

Look carefully.

In each light ball, there is a young creature.

It looks bigger than a human body, and both eyes are purple.

Generally speaking, it is not much different from others.

Lu Daosheng glanced at him and found that there were about thirty people.

"That's all?"

Lu Daosheng said indifferently.

Hearing this, the phantom snorted, "These are enough to sweep away all the younger generations there."

"Hahaha, interesting."

Lu Daosheng couldn't help laughing.

Yan Lingyun, who was standing beside her, didn't say anything, but looking at the expressions of the light balls, she was full of disdain.

That's all, it's not enough for her baby daughter to beat her.

Well, that's what Yan Lingyun thought in her heart.

No one can compare to her daughter.

The phantom said nothing about this, just leave everything to the facts.

"Okay, when the battle of luck begins, I will put them in. As for how much I can live, it depends on their own. I will not interfere."

Lu Daosheng looked at the sleeping guys in the light ball and said lightly.

Hearing this, the phantom nodded.

After Lu Daosheng and the others left, the phantom stood there, looking at the direction of the abyss, muttering to himself.

"I hope you don't regret today's decision."

.........

Immortal Realm, Heaven and Earth Academy.

The huge movement quickly attracted the students in the academy.

Basically, all the disciples from the outer courtyard ran to the gate of the academy and watched this very ornamental battle.

Buzz —

The deafening sound of the knife kept ringing.

Every time Dao Qing slashes the broken knife in his hand, a knife light will be slashed out, revealing its sharpness.

And not far from Daoqing.

The boy did not choose to resist.

After all, his biggest advantage is his speed.

If you resist with your body, wouldn’t that be a fool?

"Do you just hide?"

Finally, Dao Qing couldn't help but yell.

At this moment, there were already fine beads of sweat on Dao Qing's face, and he was obviously a little tired.

Hearing this, the boy in the distance stopped.

At this moment, the people in the academy who were watching the battle could see the boy's face clearly.

I don't know him, but I'm a little handsome.

"Hmph, can you control it? This is called tactics. If you have a genital, just catch me!"

The boy snorted coldly, his face also had a little bad.

Dao Qing was a little tired, so why didn't he?

He was also shocked at this moment.

Before coming to Tiandi Academy, he was still full of confidence, but when he arrived at the academy, he couldn't even beat the doorkeeper, which made him feel very distracted.

Is this Tiandi Academy so high-end? Even the doorkeeper is so powerful.

In the distance, Dao Qing took a deep breath and his expression suddenly became calm.

"I like running, right?"

Buzz —

The space trembled, and Daoqing's breath suddenly began to change.

A stream of domineering sword energy continued to overflow from Daoqing's body.

In just a moment, a vortex formed by the gathering and rotating of the knife energy appeared outside the academy gate with the knife raising as the center.

"Blade tornado!"

Dao Qing shouted angrily and rushed directly forward.

It was also at this moment that the vortex spread rapidly and had a huge range. If it weren't for the academy's shield, I'm afraid that all the students who watched the game would suffer.

In the distance, the boy was also shocked.

This knife-wielding trick is actually hidden in this trick.

But there was no fear in the boy's eyes.

laugh!

The vortex hit and the boy's body trembled.

Suddenly, a force of rules covered the boy's entire body.

The next moment, the boy disappeared directly.

"Then, that's the law of speed!"

"wrong!"

A college tutor looked at the scene in front of him and said in a disgusting voice: "It's not the law of speed, it's the domain!"

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

domain? !

Could it be?

Everyone looked at it again and immediately understood.

I saw that at some point, the entire academy was shrouded in an extremely inconspicuous domain.

And that young man's speed will be greatly improved in this domain.

However, no matter how fast you are, you can only hide.

How can we break the tornado of Daoqing?

"Damn it, you guys see!"

Another person exclaimed.

Everyone looked at each other and saw a figure speeding rapidly, and it began to accelerate outside the tornado surrounding Daoqing.

The boy's intention is obvious.

Dao Qing inside the sword tornado also knew what the other party was thinking.

But at this moment, he had no other way, it depends on who is more powerful.

Thinking of this, Dao Qing also worked harder.

boom!

The vortex is getting bigger and bigger, and the speed of the tornado is getting faster and faster.

In this way, the two sides had been in a stalemate for a long time.

Somewhere away from here, the boy in yellow robe stood in the void, quietly watching the battle below.

Next to him, an old man dressed in the costume of a college tutor was also standing here, watching quietly.

It is Tan Songci.

"The successor of the Broken Sword Immortal Emperor actually joined your Tiandi Academy?"

The old man in yellow robe looked at the one below and said lightly.

Upon hearing this, Tan Songci on the side smiled and said, "My academy is not as capable as yet."

The old man in yellow robe frowned slightly.

At this moment, the two of them suddenly changed their faces, and then they suddenly looked in another direction outside the academy.

"That's!"

The old man in yellow robe looked shocked.

Tan Songci's eyes were slightly red, "I'm back, I'm back."

"Huh? Why do I feel a little hot all of a sudden?"

At the entrance of the academy, a student wiped the sweat beads from his forehead.

Hearing this, the rest of the people nodded slightly.

"I also feel it, is this frictional heat generation?"

Everyone looked at the two people who were still competing against each other and felt a lot of emotion.

I don’t know when it will reach the level of both of them.

However, just as everyone was thinking, a fire suddenly flew towards the distance and then rushed straight towards Dao Qing and the others.

boom!

Then there was a loud noise.

The entire academy suddenly turned into a sea of fire.

The two flew in the opposite direction, both groaning.

"Who, who attacks?!"

Dao Qing struggled to get up, his face looked ugly and ugly.
